notes.title: Update - Steam Cloud Support!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We've released a small update to Z3TA+ 2 Steam:

• Added Steam Cloud support - Users may now run the standalone Z3TA+ 2 microhost and save presets into a Steam Cloud synced folder. Bring your favorite presets to any installation.  Presets saved to here in the Z3TA+ 2 Demo will also carry over to the full version.

We've made a helpful guide on how to leverage this new feature here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=956266855
• We've also updated SteamReg to the latest version

notes.title: Z3TA+ 2.2.3.51 - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

The 2.2.3.51 update is now available for all Z3TA+ 2 Steam owners.
[list][*] Resolved an issue with timing on Windows 10 that could cause a crash
[*] Core authorization library has been updated
[*] A bug with long arpeggio MIDI files causing drawing errors has been fixed
[*] A bug resulting in incorrect CC selection has been fixed
[/list]

This includes all the prior fixes that were recently available in a beta branch. 

Please restart the Steam client if the update does not show up.

notes.title: Note: Instability with certain Cakewalk plugins after recent Windows 10 updates
notes.content:
[b]Note: Cumulative Update for Windows 10 Version 1607 for x64-based Systems (KB3201845) appears to resolve the issue stated below. Make sure  to check your Windows 10 updates, if you are having issues. [/b]

It has come to our attention that a recent Windows 10 update has introduced instability in a subset of our plug-ins and may cause SONAR or other Windows DAWs to crash. The problem is related to a change in the timing for thread initialization on Windows, which leads to intermittent crashing on project load, plug-in scanning, or adding these plug-ins to a project. We are able to reproduce the issue and it appears to only affect some systems since it is timing related. 

We are actively working on a resolution and will release fixes to the affected plugins as soon as possible.

Plug-ins that may be affected:[list]
[*] CA-2A
[*] Rapture Pro
[*] Rapture Session
[*] Z3TA+2[/list]

We appreciate your patience while we work to resolve this issue,

- Cakewalk

notes.title: Z3TA+ 2.2.3 Update and New DLC's - Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]New Content Available:[/h1]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/293101]BigTone EDM[/url] downloadable content is now available to purchase.
[url=http://store.steampowered.com//app/293095]Cakewalk Mutant R3LOAD[/url] downloadable content is now available to purchase.

[h1]General Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*] Core authorization library has been updated
[*] A bug with long arpeggio MIDI files causing drawing errors has been fixed
[*] A bug resulting in incorrect CC selection has been fixed
[/list]
[h1]Steam Specific Changes:[/h1][list]
[*][b]SteamReg Updated[/b]
Last week we identified an issue that could impact new users registering or existing users reinstalling Z3ta+2, and the application would stay in Demo Mode. This issue has now been fixed. [/list]
[h1]Z3TA+2 Demo:[/h1][list]
[*] Updated the Demo to latest version of Z3TA+ 2
[/list]
[h1]Release Branches:[/h1]
The prior Z3TA+2 2.2.2 Update is available to rollback to if users encounter any issues.

To Rollback: 
1. Right-click ‘Z3TA+ 2’ in the Steam Client and select Properties 
2. Go to the Beta Tab 
3. Select Early-Access
4. Click [OK] and allow Steam to update.

If you're still having issues, it may be an unrelated issue. Please start a dedicated post on your issue here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/241790/discussions/2/

notes.title: Z3ta 2.2.2 Update is now available!
notes.content:
[h1][b]ATTENTION IMPORTANT:[/b][/h1]
All existing users will need to run Z3ta+2 standalone once after the update to activate Z3ta+2.2.2. Unlike 2.1, 2.2 will register both 32/64-bit plugins at the same time. Make sure to say [YES] to any Windows UAC administrator prompts. If you don't see the registration prompt, make sure you relaunch STEAM as administrator and turn off any anti-virus applications.

[h1][b]Release Notes:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Windows 10 Support
[*]AAX and VST3 Support
[*]4 Stage Phaser mono and stereo added to modulation effects
[*]Load FX from another Program
[*]Bypass button added to Arpeggiator
[/list]
[h1]Improved Search functionality:[/h1]
[list]
[*]-Search while typing
[*]-Audition patches within a search without having to reopen
[*]-Last search is now remembered
[/list]
[h1][b]New Sources and Destinations added to the Mod Matrix[/b][/h1]

[h1]Sources:[/h1]
[list][*]Alternate Midi: Alternates 0 1 with midi notes (can be routed to panning to make it go left right etc.)
[/list]
[h1]Destinations:[/h1]
[list][*]LFO Delay (1,2,3,4,5,6,All)
[*]ARP Velocity
[*]ARP Length
[*]Chorus Delay
[*]Chorus Feedback
[*]Chorus Speed
[*]Compressor Ratio
[*]Compressor Threshold
[*]Delay Feedback (1,2,3)
[*]Reverb Dampening
[*]Envelope:(1,2,3,4,5,6, Amp)
[*]-Delay Time
[*]-Attack Time
[*]-Decay Time
[*]-Decay Level
[*]-Sustain Time
[*]-Sustain Level
[*]-Release Time
[*]-Amount
[*]-Pitch Envelope:
[*]-Delay Time
[*]-Start Level
[*]-Attack Time
[*]-Attack Level
[*]-Decay Time
[*]-Release Time
[*]-Release Level
[*]-Amount[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Resolved an issue where toggling the Keyboard (Preview Ribbon) would crash StudioOne
[*]Resolved an issue where the +/- on the Keyboard with Z3TA+ 2 in focus could cause SONAR to crash
[*]Resolved an issue where unwanted panning could occur in Z3TA+ 2.1 when left to loop over a long period of time
[*]Resolved an issue where MIDI Learn did not work for Waveshaper parameters
[*]Resolved an issue where Drag import MIDI to Arp did not work in some situations
[*]Resolved an issue where Preset Inc/Dec and Random did not MIDI learn correctly
[*]The Microhost now has a Sample Rate selector on the UI
[*]Removed the unintended "Audio Input" control from the mod matrix
[*]Resolved an issue where exporting a MIDI file from Z3TA+2 arp, and re-importing the MIDI file results in +1 Octave
[*]Resolved an issue reported where Z3TA+ 2.1 would not not automate waveshaper parameters with host-synchronized LFO (CWBRN-8874)
[*]Resolved an issue where text for modulation parameters was being cut off in master display
[*]Resolved an issue where the Preset name would displays a GUI glitch when searching and selecting a preset
[*]Resolved an issue where the Search box was visible on credits/signal flow screen if no text is entered
[*]Resolved an issue where clicking extreme-left of Shaper would flip it
[*]Resolved an issue where meters and poly count jump thru about page GUI
[*]Resolved a patch specific issue (Showcase) Bass Shape 01 FS Delay 1 where it would become non functional
[*]Resolved an issue where Waveshaper controls behave differently on User waves
[*]Resolved an issue where the mod matrix could becomes unresponsive
[*]Resolved an issue where Sync on Modulation was inconsistent when triggering vs played back in SONAR
[*]Resolved an issue where CC# 43 displays as 33 in right-click menu when mapping parameters
[*]Resolved an issue where the Stereo Chorus was not processing as true stereo chorus
[*]Resolved a potential memory leak/potential crash when using the random program picker
[*]Updated many buttons to have proper tooltips
[*]Resolved an issue where the Z3TA+ Microhost menus did not behave as expected when using Record WAV File
[*]Improved responsiveness with controls, such as Filter Link and Control Previews, which were lagging in OSX
[*]Resolved an issue when choosing some program names that displayed unrelated "Parameter 659:" tooltip[/list]

[h1][b]Hotfix Update:[/b][/h1]
2.2.16 - 6:30EST - We just pushed out a quick hotfix this afternoon that addressed one issue. The registry keys for VST3 linking had a slight typo. If you're having problems linking the VST3 version of Z3ta+ 2 with our plugin linker applet, run a re-verify of the application cache.

notes.title: Z3TA+2 STEAM Update
notes.content:
We've posted a new update for the STEAM version of Z3TA+2

[h1]Changes:[/h1][list]
[*] Added the STEAM Plugin Manager, which is also bundled with Rapture Pro and Cakewalk Sound Center. This allows a user to link plugins in the STEAM managed directory, back to their system global vst folder. 
[*] Changed the order of launch options. Now 64-bit will be listed first on compatible systems. This should help resolve some of the issues Music Creator 7 users have, since the default MC7 option is 64-bit.
[*] Plug-in .dll's were previously under a '64bit' and '32bit' subfolder in the 'Vstplugins/Z3TA+ 2' or 'x64/Vstplugins/Z3TA+2' folders. They have been removed from these subfolders and now just live in their respective 'Z3TA+2' folder.
[*] STEAM install script cleanup. x86 users will now only have the native x86 version. Previously, users would have both x86 and x64 on their system, regardless of compatibility. 
[*] Foundation laid for more Z3TA+ 2 Expansion packs.
[/list]

notes.title: Z3ta+ 2 Updates
notes.content:
Previous installations of Z3ta+2 – Steam, created a folder ‘Cakewalk Content\Z3ta+2’ on C:\. 

Due to customer requests this has changed:
[list]
[*]Installations will now reference the ‘Cakewalk Content\Z3ta+2’ folder from your ‘Steam\SteamApps\Common\Cakewalk’ or ‘SteamLibrary\Cakewalk’ directory.
[/list]
Known Issues:
Due to this change any Expansion packs purchased outside of the Steam Store and customer created or edited content will no longer appear in the browser.
To resolve this:
[list]
[*]Copy your Expansion Packs or User created content to ‘Steam\SteamApps\Common\Cakewalk\Cakewalk Content\Z3ta+2’ or ‘SteamLibrary\Cakewalk\Cakewalk Content\Z3ta+2’ depending on your initial choice of installation paths.
[/list]
